name: @codemirror-treesitter/opendal-wasm-browser
description: Experimental browser WASM wrapper for OpenDAL-backed cloud workspace storage

scripts.build:wasm: PATH="$(dirname $(rustup which cargo)):$PATH" RUSTC="$(rustup which rustc)" bun x wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir pkg --out-name opendal_wasm_browser
scripts.check:wasm: RUSTC="$(rustup which rustc)" rustup run stable cargo check --target wasm32-unknown-unknown
